---
name: object-pooling
description: Reuse pooled message objects through Rent/Return instead of
  allocating a new instance per emit, so dispatch stays allocation-free. Use
  when adding a message type, seeing GC spikes or a rising allocation rate in
  the Unity profiler, writing an allocation test, or choosing between a pooled
  class message and a readonly struct message.
